text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a day when it's been raining cats and
dogs
since morning...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Awww... It's raining again?! I'm so sorry! This is all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well... Rice is getting all worked up
because she
thinks she's to blame for the
cherry blossom
picnic getting rained
out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It rained last week and the week before
too... It's
my fault... I brought the bad
luck again.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! This event is over, but
there'll be
other ones!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: She's right! Let's go next week!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't... You two should go without
me. It'll
just rain again if I'm there.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, Rice...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you know of any places where
we can
have a cherry blossom picnic
even if it's raining?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A botanical garden inside a greenhouse
springs to
mind, but I'm not sure it'd be
wise to send them
off in such heavy rain.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, if only there was some kind of
flower
garden that we could go to in any
weather!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Guys! Come with me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara, wait! It's pouring rain outside!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara and the others run off into
the
torrential rain. Worried about how
they'll fare, I
decide to follow them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We're... at an aquarium? Why?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Lookie there! Ta-daaah! A flower
garden!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Those are... jellyfish.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but look at the poster! "The
Fantastical
Jellyfish Exhibition: An
Underwater Flower
Garden."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see, the selection of jellyfish here look
like
flowers floating in the water. How
dreamy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're right, they do look like flowers in
bloom.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: They're so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Right?! The rain can't stop us in here!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I was wallowing so hard in my
sorrow that I
couldn't come up with any
other ideas.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're so great at finding ways to be
happy,
Urara. You always amaze me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The bright side... Yeah, you're right! I-I'll
try to do
that!
choice_data_list: 幸せは近くに転がっているかも

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I know! If you say you're happy, then more happiness is sure to come your way!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Like this... It's raining! I'm so happy!
You
should give it a shot too, Rice! Go on!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so happy?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! Here I am at the aquarium with
Rice and
Rob Roy! I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, I'm so happy! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is it the power of words or Haru Urara's

positivity? Either way, Rice Shower is
positively
beaming.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-you think so? Right around the corner,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You mean that poster there? For the
dolphin
meet-and-greet?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I bet we'll all make some great memories
if we go
and play with the dolphins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dolphins perform huge leaps in time
with the
jolly music. But then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Squee, squee! Squeee... SPLASH!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oooh... I'm so sorry. I got all of you
splashed with
water!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Don't be sorry! That's what dolphin
shows are all
about!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That was so much fun! We should
go and
see the dolphins again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
For sure, Urara! I'd love to go again with
you
both.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much, you two!
